mintAuthority.summary: srUSDe is an ERC-4626 senior-risk wrapper over USDe; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable USDe mint authority is inherited from reviewed Ethena signed-order controls.

controls.label: srUSDe ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: Ethereum RPC asset() returned USDe 0x4c9EDD5852cd905f086C759E8383e09bff1E68B3; parent USDe has reviewed mintAuthority. Re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 25570877: EIP-1967 impl 0xe894055ca1c73648927e225f3ca38ed48e30210b, admin ProxyAdmin 0x30a17d6bcbdbf1579d6fbba453acf776d01fbb50, whose owner() is TimelockController 0xb2a3cf69c97afd4de7882e5fee120e4efc77b706 (getMinDelay() = 172800 s). The wrapper only does deposit/share accounting; it does not mint base USDe.

controls.label: Strata 2-day TimelockController (srUSDe ProxyAdmin owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, srUSDe ProxyAdmin.owner() returned this TimelockController and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. The delayed timelock is the immediate controller that can authorize a replacement of the wrapper's mint-critical implementation.

controls.label: Strata 3-of-4 proposer Safe
controls.evidence: RoleGranted history from deployment records this Safe as the sole TimelockController PROPOSER_ROLE holder, with no RoleRevoked event. At Ethereum block 25573280, on-chain Safe reads returned version 1.3.0, the four listed owners, threshold 3, an empty module list, and a zero guard. It can schedule, but not bypass, the two-day upgrade delay.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26113561 (hash 0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e), the wrapper's EIP-1967 implementation remains verified Tranche 0xe894055ca1c73648927e225f3ca38ed48e30210b and asset() is USDe. Tranche's base-asset deposit/mint delegates to ERC4626Upgradeable, whose _deposit transfers assets before minting shares; its meta-token _deposit likewise safeTransferFroms the token before _mint and calls CDO.deposit. No external privileged share mint or minter-registration function is present in this implementation. The 3-of-4 Safe can schedule wrapper upgrades through the 172800-second timelock, but upgrade authority alone is not a D14 trigger. Allocation, strategy and deposit-limit changes are parameter powers, not deposit-free share issuance. Ethena's unbounded parent USDe issuance is carried by inheritedFrom and the serial-claim dependency edge, not charged again as wrapper-local mint authority.

sources.label: Verified current Tranche implementation and ERC4626Upgradeable deposit/share mechanics
Verified Tranche implementation: deposit-backed base and meta share issuance

review.evidence: Historical review on 2026-07-20 resolved the srUSDe transparent proxy to Tranche 0xe894055ca1c73648927e225f3ca38ed48e30210b and ProxyAdmin 0x30a17d6bcbdbf1579d6fbba453acf776d01fbb50, owned by Timelock 0xb2a3cf69c97afd4de7882e5fee120e4efc77b706. Role-event history identified the 3-of-4 proposer Safe, open executor role and self-administered timelock; wrapper minting was deposit/share accounting over parent USDe. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26113561 (hash 0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e): asset() still returns USDe, the implementation slot still names verified Tranche, ProxyAdmin.owner() still names the same timelock and getMinDelay() remains 172800. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay and hasRole confirm sole proposer Safe 0xa27ca9292268ee0f0258b749f1d5740c9bb68b50 and open executor; threshold/owners remains 3-of-4. Verified base and meta deposit/mint paths require asset transfers before share issuance; there is no wrapper-local privileged arbitrary mint/minter authorization in the current implementation. The Safe's can-authorize power is wrapper upgrade scheduling only, which D14 explicitly does not treat as arbitrary minting. Parent Ethena issuance remains on the serial-claim dependency edge and is not counted twice. Keep raiseable with sourced raiseable-collateral-only capSemanticsReview. D29 is not authored: even if an unbounded wrapper path existed, the Safe proposer fails G1; every-control execution closure is uncertified.
